messages.text: Read Design/Retrieval design and list its section headings, nothing else.
Rewrite the Goals section so the exact-phrase case comes first and is named as the one that must never fail. Keep it to three sentences.
In Indexing, add one sentence saying how much smaller int8 makes the vectors and what it costs in recall. Tom measured it; find where.
In Query, say why there is no rewriting in the first version, citing the paper that showed the exact-query loss.
Replace the Ranking section's TODO with one sentence saying reranking was settled at the September 9 meeting and pointing at that meeting note.
Does the Latency section still say 200 ms? If so, make it 150 ms per keystroke and say which meeting changed it.
Read the whole design back to me, section by section, one line each.
Which sections did we change in this chat?
